items.title: Sudan war: $22 million education boost to help 200,000 children
items.description: For millions of children in Sudan, the classroom remains out of reach as the country’s civil war continues to disrupt their education. To help tackle this huge problem, the UN global education fund on Monday announced a $22 million initiative to help 200,000 youngsters return to learning.

items.title: Ukraine's Drone War Exposes An Uncomfortable Reliance On China
items.description: Ukraine's drone industry has boomed since Russia's invasion, but it still relies on critical Chinese components. A waiver of EU procurement rules underscores Kyiv's uncomfortable wartime dependence on Beijing.
